title: "Arthur C. Lundahl" – portrait of CIA Photo-Intelligence Division chief (p. 82)
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in suit and tie in front of curtains, captioned "Arthur C. Lundahl." The text explains that DCI Allen Dulles and Richard Bissell briefed Lundahl, chief of CIA's Photo-Intelligence Division, on Project AQUATONE in December 1954, leading to Project EQUINE for exploiting U-2 photography.
